title: Mount Everest - Wikipedia
snippet: It lies in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas and marks part of the China–Nepal border at its summit. [5] Its height was most recently measured in 2020 through a joint survey by Nepalese and Chinese authorities as 8,848.86 m (29,031 ft 81⁄2 in). [6][7] Mount Everest attracts many climbers, including highly experienced mountaineers.
